summary: Fresh Reuters, Bitcoin.com, CoinDesk, market-provider and GitHub evidence. Separates Binance customer withdrawals from labeled-wallet reserve flows; separates the Tron laundering stream from XRPL stolen XRP; records Circle/Tether freeze figures by source and cutoff; diagnoses a scheduled Barrot pillar-health failure without changing secrets or external services.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Binance customer outflows reflect post-reopening custody diversification and confidence management, not a market-wide run.
supporting: Reuters reports $4.72B net outflow as 2.8% of platform assets and says withdrawals stabilized; Binance reports $2.7B inflows.
disconfirming_or_limitations: CryptoKeyhole observes substantial covered-address reserve outflows, but its tracked networks/addresses do not equal customer liabilities or XRP reserves.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Some stolen funds are being segmented and routed through cross-chain laundering infrastructure.
supporting: Six-wallet XRP redistribution; secondary reporting of approximately $242M moved through Tron-related routes and THORChain/bridges.
disconfirming_or_limitations: No sale of the six XRPL XRP recipient balances established; Tron and XRPL flows are distinct.

causal_hypotheses.claim: Stablecoin issuer controls are reducing recoverability gaps relative to native XRP.
supporting: Reuters reports Circle froze more than $1.1B USDC; earlier TRM snapshots record USDC/USDT/RLUSD freezes; native XRP has no issuer freeze mechanism.
disconfirming_or_limitations: Freeze totals differ by cutoff/scope; frozen does not mean recovered or returned.

causal_hypotheses.claim: XRP price weakness/strength around the incident is driven by broader risk sentiment, leverage and liquidity as well as XRP-specific flows.
supporting: BTC/ETH market recovery and broad derivatives liquidation data; provider-scoped XRP depth and open-interest dispersion.
disconfirming_or_limitations: No synchronized event study or causal model run; no directional forecast issued.
